ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

FIGURE: voluptuous, generously curved at bust, hips and thighs — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.
